questions.question: The arc length of a sector of a circle that subtends a 22.5° angle at the centre is given as 16.5 cm. What will be the radius (in cm) of the circle? [Use π = (22)/(7)]
questions.solution:
Given:

Arc length = 16.5 cm

Angle subtended by Arc = 22.5°

The radius of the circle = r

Formula used:

The angle subtended by an arc (in Radian) = (Length of arc)/Radius

The arc length of a sector = (θ/360°) × 2πr

Calculation:

(θ/360°) × 2πr = 16.5

⇒ 22.5/360 ×(22/7 × r) = 16.5

⇒ r/14 = 3

⇒ r = 42 cm

∴ The radius of the circle is 42cm.

questions.question: A sells a cycle to B at a profit of 33% and B sells it to C at a loss of 25%. If C bought the cycle for Rs. 3,059. then the cost price of it for A was:
questions.solution:
**Given**

C.P of C = 3059

Profit = 33%

Loss = 25%

**Formula used**

S.P = (100 + profit)/100 × C.P

Profit of A = 33% = 33/100

Loss of B = 25% = 1/4

Let the cost price of A = Rs.400 ( product of 4 and 100)

⇒ Profit of A = 400 × 33/100 = Rs.132

⇒ Selling price of A = 400 + 132 = Rs.532

⇒ Cost price of B = Rs.532

B sold to C at a loss of 1/4

⇒ Loss of B = 532 × 1/4 = Rs.133

⇒ Selling price of B = 532 - 133 = Rs.399

⇒ Cost price of C = Rs.399

399 → 3059

400 → 3059/399 × 400

400 → 9200/3 = 3066(2/3)

**The answer is 3066(2/3).**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__** 

Let the C.P of A be x.

⇒ x × 133/100 × 3/4 = 3059

⇒ x = 9200/3 or 3066(2/3)

questions.question: If (4y-(4)/(y))=11, find the value of (y²+(1)/(y²)).
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Given, 4(y − 1/y) = 11 ⇒ y − 1/y = 11/4

Direct formula: If x − 1/x = a, then x² + 1/x² = a² + 2

⇒ y² + 1/y² = (11/4)² + 2

⇒ y² + 1/y² = 121/16 + 2 = 153/16

⇒ 153/16 = 9 ⁹/₁₆

**∴ The correct answer is 9 ⁹/₁₆.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

4y − 4/y = 11

**Formula Used:**

(a − b)² = a² + b² − 2ab

**Calculations:**

⇒ 4(y − 1/y) = 11

⇒ y − 1/y = 11/4

Squaring both sides:

⇒ (y − 1/y)² = (11/4)²

⇒ y² + 1/y² − 2 × y × (1/y) = 121/16

⇒ y² + 1/y² − 2 = 121/16

⇒ y² + 1/y² = 121/16 + 2

⇒ y² + 1/y² = (121 + 32) / 16

⇒ y² + 1/y² = 153/16 = 9 ⁹/₁₆

**∴ The correct answer is 9 ⁹/₁₆.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Algebraic Identities for Squares

If x + 1/x = a, then x² + 1/x² = a² − 2

Algebraic Identities for Cubes

If x + 1/x = a, then x³ + 1/x³ = a³ − 3a

Difference to Sum Conversion

If x − 1/x = a, then x + 1/x = √(a² + 4)

questions.question: Basanthi deposited Rs. 50,000 in a co-operative bank which is giving compound interest at the rate of 10% per annum. What will be her interest in the 3rd year?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Interest for the 1st year = 10% of 50,000 = Rs. 5,000.

In Compound Interest, the interest earned each subsequent year grows successively by the rate percentage.

Interest for 3rd year = Interest for 1st year × (1 + 10/100)²

Interest for 3rd year = 5000 × 1.1 × 1.1 = 6050

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 6,050.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = Rs. 50,000

Rate (R) = 10% per annum compound interest

Time period = 3rd year

**Formula Used:**

Interest for a specific year is calculated on the total amount accrued up to the previous year.

 Year 1
 
 
 60.5k
 Year 2
 
 
 66.55k
 Year 3

 I&sub3; = 6050

**Calculation:**

⇒ Interest for 1st year = 10% of 50,000 = Rs. 5,000

⇒ Amount after 1st year = 50,000 + 5,000 = Rs. 55,000

⇒ Interest for 2nd year = 10% of 55,000 = Rs. 5,500

⇒ Amount after 2nd year = 55,000 + 5,500 = Rs. 60,500

⇒ Interest for 3rd year = 10% of 60,500 = Rs. 6,050

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 6,050.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Increment in CI

In compound interest, the interest earned each successive year forms a geometric progression with a common multiplier of (1 + R/100).

Compound Interest Total Amount Formula

The total amount after n years is directly calculated as A = P(1 + R/100)ⁿ, where P is the principal and R is the rate of interest.

Difference Between SI and CI (2 Years)

The difference between compound interest and simple interest for exactly two years is derived using the formula: Difference = P(R/100)².

questions.question: If the simple interest on Rs. 2,500 is more than the interest on Rs. 1,500 by Rs. 360 in 3 years. then find the rate of interest per annum.
questions.solution:
Given:

Principal₁ = Rs. 2500

Principal₂ = Rs. 1500

Time = 3 years

S.I = 360

Formula used:

SI = (PRT)/100

where, 

SI is Simple interest, P is Principal, R is Rate, T is Time and A is Amount

Calculations:

According to the question, we have

⇒ SI = (PRT)/100

⇒ 360 = ((2500 - 1500) × R × 3))/100

⇒ R = 12%

∴ The rate of interest per annum is 12%.

questions.question: A is twice a good worker as B and together they finish the work in 20 days. In how many days can A alone do it?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Efficiency of A = 2 × efficiency of B

**Concept used:**

If total work is constant then,

Efficiency ∝ (1/time)

**Formula used:**

Total work = efficiency × time

**Calculation:**

Efficiency of A : Efficiency of B = 2 : 1

Total work = (2 + 1) × 20

⇒ 3 × 20 = 60

Time taken by A to do the same work = 60/2 

⇒ 30 days

**∴ The correct answer is 30 days.**

questions.question: If the two interior opposite angles of an exterior angle of a triangle are 35°and 65°, then the measurement of the exterior angle is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

First interior angle = 35°

Second interior angle = 65° 

**Concept used:**

The sum of the interior opposite angle is equal to the exterior angle.

**Calculation:**

The measurement of exterior angle = first interior angle + second interior angle

⇒ 35° + 65° = 100° 

**∴ The correct answer is 100°.**

questions.question: If sec A=(17)/(15), then what is the value of cot A?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Sec A = 17/15

**Formula used:**

Sec θ = H/B

By Pythagoras theorem:

⇒ H² = P² + B²

Where H = hypotenuse ; P = perpendicular

and B = base

**Calculation:**

Sec A = 17/15 = H/B

By Pythagoras theorem:

⇒ H2 = P2 + B2

⇒ 17² = P² + 15²

⇒ P = √(289 - 225)

⇒ P = √64 = 8

So, cot A = B/P 

⇒ 15/8

**∴ The correct answer is 15/8.**

questions.question: A train travelling at 80 km/h crosses another train travelling in the same direction at 26 km/h in 30 seconds. What is the combined length of both the trains?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Speed of first train = 80 km/h

Speed of second train = 26 km/h

**Concept used:**

If both trains moving in the same direction then,

Relative speed = difference of speed of both trains

**Formula used:**

Distance = relative speed × time

**Calculation:**

Let the length of the first train = T₁

Length of second train = T₂

Distance = relative speed × time

⇒ T1 + T2 = (80 - 26) × (5/18) × 30

⇒ 54 × (5/18) × 30

⇒ 15 × 30 = 450 m

**∴ The correct answer is 450 m.**
